chunk.content: Yellowfin tuna (Thunnus albacares), one species within Fishora's genus-level tuna label, is marketed fresh, frozen, canned, and smoked, and is valued for sashimi.
chunk.source_quote: Marketed mainly fresh, frozen, canned (Ref. 9684), but also smoked (Ref. 9987). Highly valued for sashimi (Ref. 26938).
